description: Machine-readable index of AVP conformance vectors. A harness can enumerate this instead of hardcoding filenames. Prose explanation: vectors/README.md. Each entry: file (relative to vectors/), kind, specSection, and the published anchors a conformant implementation must reproduce.

kinds.deterministic: Pure byte/string construction with no key material; must match exactly.
kinds.rfc-primitive: A cryptographic primitive pinned to a published RFC test vector.
kinds.composition: Full AVP composition with fixed keys/IVs; reproduce byte-for-byte and round-trip (decrypt/unwrap/verify).
kinds.negative: A valid construction with one mutation that a conformant implementation MUST reject.
kinds.data: A plaintext data transformation with no key material (the payload merge and the HLC); the result must equal the expected JSON exactly.
kinds.scenario: A sequence of signed items applied to one host's rules engine; each step's verdict and the final heads, held commits, and tip must match.

vectors.construction: 24-word BIP39 English mnemonic of 32-byte entropy (wordlist bip39-english.txt); seed = PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(NFKD(mnemonic), "mnemonic" || NFKD(passphrase), 2048, 64); ed25519Seed / x25519Private = HKDF-SHA256(seed, empty, "avp/owner/ed25519/v1" / "avp/owner/x25519/v1", 32)
vectors.expects: mnemonic, seed, owner Ed25519 seed and public key, owner X25519 private and public key; the Trezor anchors reproduce with passphrase TREZOR

vectors.construction: S = CE(tag "avp/manifest/v1", ...) with sorted hosts, members, removals, frontier; ownerSignature = Ed25519(ownerKey, S); manifestHash = SHA-256(S || ownerSignature); repoId = base64url-nopad(SHA-256(CE(tag "avp/repo-id/v1", bytes(ownerKey), bytes(genesisNonce)))[0..16])
vectors.expects: stateHex, ownerSignature, manifestHashHex, and repoId at seq 1, independent of list input order

vectors.construction: H = CE(tag "avp/commit/v1", ...) with sorted parents; commitId = SHA-256(H); authorSignature = Ed25519(author, CE(tag "avp/commit-sig/v1", bytes(commitId))); AAD v2 = CE(tag "avp/aad/v2", str(repoId), i64(keyEpoch), bytes(author), sorted parents); AES-256-GCM, 12-byte IV, 16-byte tag appended
vectors.expects: headerHex, commitIdHex, authorSignature, aadHex, and ciphertext, independent of parent order; decrypt recovers plaintextUtf8

vectors.construction: payload v2 merge: union of accounts, greatest (at, n, by) stamp per field and per ban server id, greatest deleted marker; deleted iff deleted is greater than every field and ban stamp; stripRefresh removes refreshToken and expiresAt with their stamps (5.1); HLC tick and observe
vectors.expects: expected for every permutation of inputs, idempotence, associativity, expectedDeleted per account; each hlc step's state

vectors.construction: owner-signed manifest chains (including diverged states), signed commit graphs, and leave requests applied in order to one host's rules engine, by client push or replication offer
vectors.expects: each step's verdict (ok or the SPEC 10.4 code); finalHeads, finalHeld, finalTip
vectors.shape: uses a top-level `scenarios` array, not `cases`; see vectors/README.md for the step shape
vectors.generatedBy: vectors/generate.ts (verdicts hand-written from the cited SPEC rule)

vectors.expects: public key derived from seed; deterministic signature reproduced and verified
vectors.note: The primitive under every AVP signature. The challenge -> token signature is over the avp/challenge/v1 transcript (SPEC 3.3), pinned in federation.json `challenges`.

vectors.construction: X25519-HKDF-SHA256-AESGCM-v1: KEK = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=X25519(eph,recip), salt=ephPubRaw, info=UTF8("avp/rdk-wrap/v1")); AES-256-GCM(KEK, iv, aad=UTF8("avp/rdk-wrap/v1"), dataKey)
vectors.expects: recompute shared secret + KEK; re-wrap equals committed ciphertext; unwrap recovers the data key
vectors.note: recipientPrivateKeyB64, sharedSecretHex, kekHex are checker aids, NOT part of the wire WrappedKey

vectors.construction: base64url-nopad over compact JSON for InviteToken (with the host-signed Acceptance), RepoLocator, LinkRequest, LinkGrant (owner entropy wrapped under avp/owner-link/v1); LeaveRequest signatures; link confirmation codes; member and owner fingerprints; avp://<hostLocator>/<repoId> locators; challenge transcripts CE(tag "avp/challenge/v1", bytes(hostKey), bytes(ed25519PublicKey), bytes(nonce)) and their signatures
vectors.expects: decoding base64url yields the object; canonical encoding round-trips; acceptance and leave signatures verify; link codes and fingerprints recompute; the link grant unwraps to the owner entropy; avp:// URIs parse and format back; each challenge messageHex recomputes and its signature verifies under the named hostKey only

vectors.construction: valid key-wrap / ed25519 constructions and 0.5 manifest, commit, payload, link grant, acceptance, and leave items with one mutation each (flipped tag or byte, truncation, wrong key, wrong owner signature, wrong previous hash, commit id that does not recompute, author signature over another id, AAD v2 with a wrong parent set, epoch, author, or repoId, wrong wrap label), and challenge domain separation cases (a challenge signature presented as a commit author signature and the reverse, a challenge signature for another host key, a signature over the raw nonce)
vectors.expects: each case MUST be rejected: unwrap and decrypt fail authentication, verify returns false, the link check fails; each 0.5 case's `base` is accepted
vectors.generatedBy: vectors/generate.ts (from the same seeds as the positive vectors)
